class_e_alignment: Source records design_defect at Makefile:47-48: test:lint coupling causes make test to abort before pytest runs when mypy/ruff exit non-zero, and --unsafe-fixes mutates source as a side effect. This change removes lint from the test: prerequisite list (Makefile:47: test: lint -> test:) so make test exit code reflects only pytest outcomes. The lint target at Makefile:33-35 is preserved intact. CI lint quality is maintained via needs:linter at main.yml:85,113,135.
